method: One-step policy improvement by 7-day common-scenario rollout of frozen learned RL policy. Future weekday features known from calendar, input history frozen at decision cutoff. Learned centroids and five bootstrap fits inherited unchanged; no language model. Hybrid RL+planning, not pure learned execution. Strong matched 28-day rollout included.
selection: Strongest same-filter normal-validation baseline; fixed candidate horizon7. All original benefit and safety admission gates retained. No holdout retuning.
scope: Public arrival proxy, local queue assumed, synthetic stress, finite action resource surrogate; no financial/physical port benefit claim.
diagnostic: 90-step exact hindsight MILP, allowed original safety constraints; oracle output never used by deployable policy. Separately reports theoretical cost headroom.
